story: story-042 (MultiPooler batch pool() + parameterize Uniboost pool amount)

newFindings.title: MultiPooler same-pool in-batch floor staleness
newFindings.rootCause: Per-row keeper floors are computed against pre-batch reserves; an earlier row's swaps move a shared UniV2 pool so a later row targeting a dispatcher on that same pool floors against stale reserves.
newFindings.impact: Either whole batch reverts (self-DoS, no loss) or degraded add bounded by row-2's own minPairOut/minTargetOut/minLP. POL-owned, keeper-controlled, bounded.
newFindings.novelty: Genuinely new — batching surface introduced by story-042; distinct root cause (intra-batch cross-row staleness) from L-06 (single-tx external MEV).
newFindings.reason: Surfaced as new QA footgun, not collapsed into L-06: different mechanism (own-batch ordering vs external sandwich) and different mitigation (batch-order/dedup awareness vs floor-tightness).

collapsedIntoExisting.reason: Same class/instance as L-06 (Uniboost LP-add minAmounts=(0,0), protection = keeper floors only, no on-chain oracle/TWAP). econ-scanner confirms not escalated by story-042: amountIn parameterization is MEV-neutral-to-beneficial. No re-report; L-06 stays Low/open.
